children: (NYSE: KRMN) is scheduled to participate in the following September investor conferences:
2026 Jefferies Global Industrials Conference on September 10 in New York City
Morgan Stanley 14th Annual Laguna Conference on September 16 in Dana Point, CA

Karman management will host institutional investor meetings at the conferences. Institutional investors may contact Jefferies and Morgan Stanley to request one-on-one meetings with management. Webcasts of management fireside chats at the conferences will be accessible via the Investors section of the Company’s website at

Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation systems that align with the core mission priorities of the U.S. Department of War and its allies and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Hydro/Aerodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to 150 prime contractors supporting 150 space and defense programs. Karman is headquartered in Huntington Beach, Calif., with multiple facilities across the United States. For more information, visit our website,
